sloka: अदितेः आत्मजा वीरा दितेः पुत्रान् निजघ्निरे ।अस्मिन् घोरे महायुद्धे दैतेया अदित्यायोः भृशम् ॥१-४५-४४॥
transliteration: aditeḥ ātmajā vīrā diteḥ putrān nijaghnire ।asmin ghore mahāyuddhe daiteyā adityāyoḥ bhṛśam ॥1-45-44॥

translations.english: Indra, having killed the sons of Diti was happy with the kingdom gained. He ruled the worlds in the company of rishis and celestial singers". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे पञ्चचत्वारिंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the fortyfifth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
